=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:695-716 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In the check_one recurred branch, the reopen PATCH has already dropped ai:verify-pending and added ai:planning/ai:needs-human, so when the failed-check comment POST then fails, the new early `return False` skips the recurred marker and the `_journal(... "fail", failure=...)` entry, leaving the issue untracked.
  WHY: `check` never sees the issue again because the label is gone, and standalone stall recovery later re-plans it with no marker, so replan_count() undercounts, PERSIST_MAX_APPROACHES can be exceeded and P1 loses the failure_key record; severity disagreement: MAJOR (minimax, luna, glm) vs NIT (sonnet), highest used.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:643-651 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fallback workflow-runs read fetches one page (`per_page=100`, newest first) and never paginates, so the merge-commit run can be pushed off the page and select_run grades a later run instead.
  WHY: On a busy workflow, a later green run gets the marker graded `held` and ai:verify-pending removed, so a real post-merge failure on the merge-commit run is never handled; severity MAJOR (minimax, luna, glm), gemini gave no severity; sonnet raised the same issue only as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:529-539,633-638 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: cmd_arm adds ai:verify-pending before it posts the pending-marker comment, so a concurrent poller tick between the two writes takes the `marker is None` branch and removes the label as `marker_absent`, and nothing re-adds it.
  WHY: `check` finds candidates only by label and the two workflows share no concurrency group, so the merge is silently never graded; severity disagreement: MAJOR (minimax) vs NIT (luna, glm), highest used; glm confidence 2, others 4; sonnet raised the same issue only as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:47-49 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The docstring's contractual log spec `PERSIST postmerge outcome=<armed|ok|held|pending|recurred|unverified|cleaned|skipped|error>` leaves out `deferred`, which the code emits at line 606 (`log("deferred", "budget_absent", number)`) and at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19566 (`outcome=deferred reason=phase_capped`), and which the agents.d registry lists.
  WHY: Log consumers keyed to the docstring contract will not recognise `deferred` lines; the docstring, the registry and the emitters disagree.
- agents.d/8427-p5-persist-postmerge-verify.md:10 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The API-budget bullet (and the docstring at scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:54-56) says "1 workflow-runs read (cache miss only)", but check_one at line 643 also re-reads when the cached run's head is not the merge commit, which the fragment's own Check bullet documents; sonnet adds that arm can make up to 4 writes, not 3 (two label POST attempts).
  WHY: Operators who budget API calls from these lines undercount by up to one read per affected candidate per tick; the code itself is not affected.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:691-693,606 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: With PERSIST_BUDGET_ENABLED=true and persist_budget.py absent, _budget_owner logs `outcome=deferred reason=budget_absent`, then the caller logs `outcome=recurred reason=replan|escalated` for the same issue.
  WHY: Operators filtering on `outcome=deferred` read the issue as parked while it is actually being re-planned (sonnet raised this inside its docstring finding, confidence 4; minimax confidence 3).
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:740-757 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: cmd_check makes the `repos/<repo>/issues?labels=...&state=all&per_page=50` list read on every tick before it checks `enabled()` / PERSIST_POSTMERGE_VERIFY_ENABLED.
  WHY: Repos with the default-off switch pay a wasted API read and Python startup cost on every tick; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputes this as documented, deliberate rollback-cleanup behaviour.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19531-19586 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: run_persist_postmerge_verify loads persist_postmerge_runs.json and always starts the Python `check` without a top-of-function `_is_truthy "${PERSIST_POSTMERGE_VERIFY_ENABLED:-false}"` short-circuit.
  WHY: Every tick on a default-off repo pays one issues-list API call plus Python startup and disk I/O; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputes this as documented, deliberate behaviour.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1654-1678 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The idle-tick `prime_phase_concurrency_snapshot` and `run_persist_postmerge_verify` calls moved into the UNBLOCK_SCAN_SWEEP_ONLY block (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 25344-25347), but the "Run unblock scan without active projects" step passes neither STALL_THRESHOLD_MINUTES nor STALL_THRESHOLD_IMPLEMENTING_MINUTES, so the snapshot always uses the 120-minute default.
  WHY: With STALL_THRESHOLD_MINUTES=240, runs aged 120-240 minutes drop out of the running count, so phase_cap_can_dispatch admits re-plans that the full poller would defer and the ai:planning cap is exceeded on idle ticks.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:91-93 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: HEADER_FAILED uses `## Check after merge failed` while HEADER_PENDING and HEADER_UNVERIFIED use `###`, and parse_markers (line 243) checks the first line by exact equality against HEADER_BY_STATE; the difference is undocumented.
  WHY: No runtime bug today, but a later change to heading levels could silently break the trust check across states.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py, scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (whole files) | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate lists `ruff` and `shellcheck` under "Failures caused by this change" in two consecutive runs, while the editor says both are clean and CI collection timed out; nobody has reconciled the two.
  WHY: A real lint failure would keep required checks red and block merge, and if they pass, the gate's classification is wrong; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 notes nothing it could read shows these as real failures.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (step "Run unblock scan without active projects", env block at lines 1654-1678) together with scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 25344-25347 (UNBLOCK_SCAN_SWEEP_ONLY block) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The idle-tick prime_phase_concurrency_snapshot call moved into the unblock block, but the unblock step does not pass STALL_THRESHOLD_MINUTES or STALL_THRESHOLD_IMPLEMENTING_MINUTES, so the snapshot ignores repo overrides and always uses 120 minutes.
  WHY: With STALL_THRESHOLD_MINUTES=240, phase_cap_can_dispatch admits re-plans the full poller would defer, so the ai:planning cap is exceeded on idle ticks; fix is to add the two env lines.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py check_one(), recurred branch | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new `return False` after the comment_write failure runs after the PATCH has dropped ai:verify-pending, so the comment post is never retried and `_journal(... "fail", failure=...)` is skipped.
  WHY: Leads to an uncounted re-plan via retrigger_plan, replan_count() undercounts, and the journal has no record; fix is to journal before returning or keep ai:verify-pending when the comment fails.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py module docstring "Log lines" spec vs _budget_owner() | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The docstring outcome list omits `deferred`; also, with budget on and no persist_budget.py, the same candidate logs `outcome=deferred reason=budget_absent` and then `outcome=recurred reason=replan`.
  WHY: Consumers keyed to the docstring miss `deferred`, and operators filtering on it read the issue as parked while it is being re-planned.
- agents.d/8427-p5-persist-postmerge-verify.md ("API budget" bullet) and scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py (docstring "API budget" paragraph) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: "1 workflow-runs read (cache miss only)" ignores the re-read on `run["head_sha"] != marker["merge_sha"]`, and arm can make up to 4 writes, not 3.
  WHY: Operators undercount reads per candidate; documentation only.
- HARDENING: scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py check_one() fresh runs read: a single page can evict the merge-commit run and produce a false `held`; return pending `runs_truncated` when total_count > the number of runs returned (4 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py check_one() `if marker is None:` branch: arm's label-before-marker order lets a tick remove the fresh label; skip removal if updated_at is within 10 minutes (4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE
